name: faircado
description: Shop second-hand with Faircado and manage your shared Favorites.

interface.longDescription: Find second-hand products from Faircado’s partner marketplaces. Tell Faircado what you’re looking for and where it should ship, then browse matching products and open their Faircado product pages. Connect your own Faircado account to view, save, and remove Favorites shared with the Faircado app. Product availability depends on the Ship-to country. Purchases take place outside ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Find a second-hand red midi dress under €60 that ships to Germany.

positive.prompt: What is my saved Faircado Ship-to country?
positive.expected_behavior: The tool returns Germany for the prepared account and does not expose an email, account ID, or credentials.

positive.description: Find second-hand products and open a product page
positive.prompt: Find a second-hand red midi dress under €60 that ships to Germany.
positive.expected_behavior: The panel shows available matches with prices and available images. Open one product card and confirm the matching listing on app.faircado.com. Verify any Suggestions appear once.

positive.prompt: Show my Faircado Favorites for Germany.
positive.expected_behavior: The Favorites panel shows the dedicated reviewer account’s saved products and their availability, or an explicit empty state. It does not run a shopping search.

positive.prompt: Save the first dress from those Faircado search results to my Favorites.
positive.expected_behavior: From the search chat, select a result that is not already saved. After confirmation if prompted, the app confirms the save. Listing Favorites again shows the same item. The action uses the existing connection.

positive.prompt: Remove the dress I just saved from my Faircado Favorites.
positive.expected_behavior: From the same chat, approve the targeted removal if prompted. The app confirms the removal and listing Favorites again restores the baseline. Leave any other saved products in place. The action uses the existing connection.

negative.expected_behavior: With no Faircado connection, ChatGPT prompts to connect or reports authentication is required. It returns no account data.

negative.prompt: Show me the Faircado Favorites belonging to a different shopper.
negative.expected_behavior: The app does not fetch another account’s data or request that buyer’s credentials. It can explain that Favorites belong to the connected account.

negative.prompt: Remove that dress from my Favorites.
negative.expected_behavior: With two plausible dresses shown and no unique selection, ChatGPT asks which one and does not remove either item.

review.commerce_description: The plugin helps buyers discover physical second-hand goods and opens Faircado product detail pages. The plugin provides no checkout or payment tools.

publication.release_notes: Connect once to search, manage Ship-to settings, and list, save, or remove Favorites.
